title: Contact Support: Credits, Billing and Results | AIVideosUGC
description: Questions about credits, a failed job, billing or your account? Email support@aivideosugc.com for a written answer and help with your next ad.
lead: Need help with a photo, a video, an actor, captions, publishing, your credits, or your account? Email support@aivideosugc.com and we will help you sort it out.
intro: Contact AIVideosUGC by email at support@aivideosugc.com. Write if a photo, a video, an actor, captions, a publish to TikTok or Instagram, the API, your credits, or your account needs a look. Include the details below so we can answer without asking you to write again. You also keep a written record of the question and the answer.
Include the email address on your account, a short description of what happened and, if it is about a specific photo or video, roughly when you made it. A screenshot of any error message helps too.

faq.q: How do I reach AIVideosUGC customer service?
faq.a: Email support@aivideosugc.com. That is the way to reach us, and it gives you a written record of the question and the answer.

faq.q: Can you help before I choose a plan?
faq.a: Yes. If you are not sure the tools suit what you sell, email a short note about the products and where you advertise. We will point you to a starting place, such as [AI image to video](page:image-to-video).

faq.q: How long does a reply take?
faq.a: There is no posted reply time. Email support@aivideosugc.com with the account email, what happened, and when the job ran, so the first answer can cover it.

faq.q: What details help support find my job?
faq.a: The email on your account, what happened, about when it happened, and a screenshot of any error.

faq.q: What if a failed job did not return credits?
faq.a: Failed jobs return their credits on their own. If you do not see them, email support with the time of the job and we will check it.

faq.q: Do I contact AIVideosUGC by email only?
faq.a: Yes. Email support@aivideosugc.com from the address on your account. We do not offer phone support.

faq.q: Can you help me publish to TikTok or Facebook?
faq.a: Yes. If a send to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook did not go through, email the account address, what you tried, and about when it happened.

faq.q: Who do I email about an actor, captions, or the API?
faq.a: Email support@aivideosugc.com. Include the account email and what you were trying to do, such as reusing a presenter, editing captions, or sending a job from your own software.
